subject: Post-call: clarify deployment paths & ballpark economics
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Mendez <elena.mendez@brightbridge.io>, Jake Lim <jake.lim@brightbridge.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Quick post-call recap + what we need to size pricing options

Hi Elena / Jake — thanks again for the time today. Short recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can put together meaningful ballpark economics for Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC.

TL;DR: We can model three slices (pilot -> steady state -> peak) but need a few usage inputs to make the numbers actionable. I attached a one-page workbook that maps tokens, concurrency and reserved commit thresholds into monthly cost ranges.

Notes from the call (high level):
- Primary workload: live patient-interaction assistant (text+some structured outputs).
- Latency target: 250–400ms 95th for short prompts; up to 1s for longer context.
- Data residency: US-only but will need audit logs and KMS integration for PHI in year 2.
- Timeline: pilot starting June, goal to scale to GA by Q4 with regional failover.

What we need to produce cost scenarios: (please reply inline or drop into the sheet)
1) Expected average tokens/request and 95th percentile tokens (separate for short & long flows).
2) Estimated qps (average and peak) and typical concurrency per request.
3) Expected % of requests requiring access to private patient context (this determines Private/VPC needs).
4) Any procurement constraints (require PO, vendor form, or preferred contract cadence).

Next steps we propose:
- You send the usage numbers into the attached workbook (or we can hop on a 30m sizing call).
- We return three ballpark pricing calls (hosted per-token, dedicated reserved commit monthly ranges, private account + licensing).
- If Dedicated or Private looks compelling, we draft a mutual action plan for pilot sizing and a draft SOW.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_deploy_workbook_v1.xlsx (xlsx), hosted_vs_dedicated_quicksheet.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks — Connor
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Mendez <elena.mendez@brightbridge.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Jake Lim <jake.lim@brightbridge.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick post-call recap + what we need to size pricing options

Hi Connor — thanks for the clear notes. Quick answers inline:

1) Tokens: short flow ~ 45 tokens avg (95th ~120). long flow ~ 750 avg (95th ~1,500) when session context is included.
2) QPS: average 1.2 qps, peak ~12 qps across all users. Concurrency: expect bursts where 25–30 concurrent model calls happen for short windows.
3) Private data: ~18% of requests will touch PHI/SSNs initially; should be considered sensitive and prefer VPC/KMS controls.
4) Procurement: we have a standard PO process, legal requires SOC2 + standard security questionnaire. Procurement lead is Sarah Park (cc'ing when we get to contracting).

I'll populate the sheet Monday morning and can set a 30m sizing call if you'd rather walk through the workbook together.

Elena
Director of Platform, BrightBridge HealthTech

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Mendez <elena.mendez@brightbridge.io>, Jake Lim <jake.lim@brightbridge.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Apr 2027 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick post-call recap + what we need to size pricing options

Perfect — thanks for the numbers, Elena. I took a first pass through the workbook with those inputs and sketched three ballpark outcomes (attached quicksheet):

Host (per-token) — Pilot (~6 weeks): $1,200–$2,400/month (low traffic). Steady: $10k–$18k/month depending on token mix. High variability on long-flow tokens drives cost here.

Dedicated (reserved commit) — Pilot: smaller commit (2–4 GPUs equivalent) with a monthly commit ~$6k–$10k. At scale: predictable monthly commit $40k–$65k for target latency and concurrency, plus lower per-token egress. Break-even vs hosted around 2.5–3M tokens/day for your mixed flows.

Private VPC/on-prem — Higher fixed seat/license: initial platform/license + infra ops estimate ~$120k–$200k one-time + monthly infra (rack/maintenance) that depends on where you host. Best when >10M tokens/day and strong compliance needs.

Key sensitivities we called out in the sheet:
- Long-flow token ratio (if >10% of calls are long flows, hosted costs rise significantly).
- Concurrency peaks — Dedicated helps flatten tail latency and reduces per-token unit cost when concurrency sustained.
- Private adds compliance but requires longer procurement runway.

Suggested next steps:
1) Grace and Priyom to review the workbook numbers and locker assumptions (Grace: on latency/SLOs; Priyom: on commit sizing).
2) Elena/Jake — confirm you'd like the 30m sizing call (we can do Wed or Thu).
3) If Procurement wants standard security artifacts, Priyom will pull the SOC2 summary and our KMS integration note and share to Sarah.

I'll attach the quicksheet and a one-slide sensitivity summary. If any of these ranges look off, tell me which scenario to prioritize and we'll tighten estimates.

Thanks — Connor

[Attachment: hosted_vs_dedicated_quicksheet.pdf (pdf), redwood_deploy_workbook_v1_filled.xlsx (xlsx)]

Sarah — can you confirm the procurement intake form and any specific contract cadence (net30, net45) BrightBridge prefers? Also let us know if you need a vendor onboarding questionnaire — we'll fill and return within 48 hours once we have the form.

Grace — can you validate the latency SLO highlighted in Connor's quicksheet so I can include it in the MAP?

Thanks — Priyom
